# Wnode Sovereign Compute & Wireless Mesh — Complete Technical & Architectural Specification

> The planetary, RAM-only background compute network monetizing idle consumer hardware with direct Stripe USD payouts and bounded two-tier rev-share.

## 1. System Architecture & RAM-Only Execution Invariants
- Stateless MicroVM & Container Sandboxing: All micro-tasks (AI inference, LLM evaluation, DeWi packet routing, web data extraction) execute strictly in volatile system memory (RAM).
- Zero SSD / Disk Wear: Guest workloads are prohibited from issuing persistent write IOPS to host storage drives (NVMe, SSD, HDD). Memory pools are zero-filled upon task termination.
- Hardware Requirements: Minimum 4GB system RAM, dual-core x86_64 or ARM64 processor, Linux/Windows/macOS OS host environment.
- Native Binary Integration: Runs `nodld` background daemon compiled to zero-dependency native Go binaries across target platforms.

## 2. Settlement & Revenue Distribution Engine
- 70% Hardware Operator Share: Hardware owners retain 70% of gross compute job revenue generated by their connected machines.
- 10% Lifetime Sales Source Fee: Origination commission paid to partners or buyers bringing compute demand to the network.
- 3% Level 1 Direct Referral Override: Direct override on active node operators brought into the network.
- 7% Level 2 Network Override: Compounding override on referral fleet expansion.
- Stripe Connect Payout Rails: Daily automated cash distributions directly to operator bank accounts via Stripe Connect once the minimum threshold ($10 minimum payout floor) is reached. Zero crypto token volatility.

## 3. Security, Privacy & Telemetry Standards
- Constant-Time Cryptographic Verification: ed25519 payload signatures and HMAC attestations.
- Zero Access to Local Files: Guest workloads operate inside SECCOMP-BPF isolated namespaces with no host filesystem access.
- Compliance: Full CCPA and GDPR compliance; zero PII collection from host machines.
